name: Currys plc
summary: Currys plc operates as a omnichannel retailer of technology products and services in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Norway, Sweden, Finland, Denmark, Iceland, Greenland, and the Faroe Islands. It offers consumer electronics and mobile technology products and services; iD Mobile, a mobile virtual network operator solution; and provides repair services, and sales of third-party insurance products. The company also involved in the sale of customer support agreements; and delivery, installation, and set-up services.
